comment: PROVENANCE (jsntrs-qr9): this group's 55 `token` values were derived in wave 5 from jsonata 2.2.2 and re-probed here — all 55 are byte-identical to what that engine attaches. The documentation specifies error CODES and never says an error carries a token at all (docs/behaviors.md 2.0.1), so `tests/conformance.rs` reports a token difference instead of failing on one and no NEW token expectation may be added. The `code` is the enforced part.
